components.title: Accordion
components.purpose: Group related optional explanations.
components.intent: Expand one named explanation while keeping other summaries reachable.
components.contract: Native details with a shared name gives exclusive opening; no scripted animation.

components.title: Alert
components.purpose: Make a condition and its next step readable together.
components.intent: Recognize an important message from its wording and structure.
components.contract: Five labelled semantic fills; mode-dependent contrasting ink. Static samples; live announcement timing belongs to actual application events.

components.title: Alert dialog
components.purpose: Focus a blocking example decision in the native top layer.
components.intent: Read the decision and cancel safely with native focus return.
components.contract: Five semantic border-only variants inside native dialogs; headings, body and controls stay on neutral surfaces. role=alertdialog + commandfor; safe close only, no data mutation.

components.title: Aspect ratio
components.purpose: Reserve a predictable media frame.
components.intent: Inspect media without distortion or layout jumps.
components.contract: 16:9 frame; object-fit contains the full source, with a written caption.

components.title: Attachment
components.purpose: Present an explicitly named file destination.
components.intent: Open the supplied local sample without a disguised action or automatic upload.
components.contract: Native link; preview parsing, upload progress and attachment permissions are separate.

components.title: Aura / emphasis border
components.purpose: Demonstrate an optional accent frame without tinting a large work area.
components.intent: Locate the explicitly labelled example emphasis without confusing it with focus.
components.contract: Five labelled semantic accent frames with neutral reading surfaces; static border, no pulsing or confusion with keyboard focus.

components.title: Avatar
components.purpose: Show an identity thumbnail or initials.
components.intent: Associate a written person name with a compact identity mark.
components.contract: Filled colored discs with checked initials contrast and adjacent names. Identity color implies no person status; no failed-image detection logic.

components.title: Badge
components.purpose: Keep short metadata visibly grouped.
components.intent: Read supplemental metadata or counts in their owner’s context.
components.contract: Additional information appears inside an inline pill or offset corner badge. Counters contain real text; a count-free dot repeats the owner’s accessible name and written explanation. Status uses a separate aligned indicator.

components.title: Breadcrumbs
components.purpose: Express a real navigation hierarchy.
components.intent: Find the parent destination and identify the current page.
components.contract: Aligned ordered levels with small aria-hidden slash separators; named nav and aria-current=page.

components.title: Chat messages
components.purpose: Group author, timestamp and message content.
components.intent: Read who said what without relying on left/right alignment or hue alone.
components.contract: Outgoing blue/end-aligned and neutral/start-aligned reply retain author, time and source order. Sending, streaming, receipts and persistence need application logic.

components.title: Button
components.purpose: Style a real action target consistently.
components.intent: Activate a named action with native pointer and keyboard behavior.
components.contract: Visual variants and disabled semantics; application actions are outside CSS.

components.title: Button group / join
components.purpose: Keep related actions adjacent while allowing wrapping.
components.intent: Recognize peer actions without hidden overflow or roving-menu semantics.
components.contract: Native buttons/links retain separate tab stops; joined framing is optional.

components.title: Calendar widget
components.purpose: Record the boundary of custom calendar behavior.
components.intent: Avoid a fake calendar that cannot navigate dates correctly.
components.contract: Month navigation, date arithmetic and custom grid keyboard behavior need logic; native date input is demonstrated separately.

components.title: Card
components.purpose: Contain one related item and its actions.
components.intent: Recognize which heading, content and action belong together.
components.contract: Content-driven height; card container itself is not a fake clickable button.

components.title: Carousel / scroll gallery
components.purpose: Offer an ordered horizontally scrollable set of panels.
components.intent: Reach every panel through native scrolling and named fragment links.
components.contract: CSS scroll snap, no auto-rotation or looping controls; full managed carousel is a separate widget.

components.title: Interactive chart
components.purpose: Keep visualization behavior distinct from decorative styling.
components.intent: Inspect actual data with correct scales and accessible alternatives.
components.contract: The upstream chart adapter uses a chart engine; data mapping, interactive legends and tooltips need logic.

components.title: Checkbox
components.purpose: Style a native multiple-choice mark.
components.intent: Toggle an explicitly labelled option without custom state synchronization.
components.contract: Native input[type=checkbox] and full-size label; checked is authoritative.

components.title: Code block
components.purpose: Bound exact source content and its label.
components.intent: Inspect selectable source with local scrolling.
components.contract: Inert pre/code; copy-to-clipboard and syntax parsing are separate logic.

components.title: Collapsible
components.purpose: Disclose optional supporting material.
components.intent: Open and close an explanation with native Enter/Space behavior.
components.contract: Native details/summary; essential instructions remain outside collapsed content.

components.title: Native suggestions
components.purpose: Offer browser-owned suggestions for an editable value.
components.intent: Choose a suggestion or retain typed text without a custom listbox.
components.contract: input + datalist; free text remains allowed. Async search and a constrained ARIA combobox need logic.

components.title: Command palette
components.purpose: Separate command discovery and execution from appearance.
components.intent: Search and invoke the intended authorized command.
components.contract: Filtering, keyboard selection and command dispatch require logic.

components.title: Context menu
components.purpose: Avoid replacing browser context behavior with a visual-only menu.
components.intent: Use a correctly positioned menu with focus and dismissal behavior.
components.contract: Context invocation, roving focus and target-specific actions require logic.

components.title: Data table engine
components.purpose: Separate a table engine from native table styling.
components.intent: Sort, filter, select and page actual records correctly.
components.contract: Static tables are included; data transformation and selection synchronization need logic.

components.title: Native date picker
components.purpose: Expose a date through the browser-owned editor.
components.intent: Choose or type a valid date with native constraints.
components.contract: input[type=date]; not a custom popover calendar or date-range engine.

components.title: Dialog / modal
components.purpose: Present a bounded modal surface with native focus handling.
components.intent: Read and dismiss a blocking explanation without losing the opener.
components.contract: Native dialog, command=show-modal/close and autofocus on safe close action; Chrome command support required.

components.title: Direction
components.purpose: Respect the document language direction through logical layout.
components.intent: Read mixed direction content without visual order hacks.
components.contract: Native dir and bdi; user content cannot inject arbitrary dir attributes through Markdown.

components.title: Drawer
components.purpose: Place a named modal support surface at an edge.
components.intent: Open and dismiss an edge panel with native focus and Escape behavior.
components.contract: Native dialog edge placement; swipe gestures, drag velocity and responsive app state are not CSS.

components.title: Dropdown links
components.purpose: Expose a compact group of navigation links on request.
components.intent: Open the link group and navigate it with ordinary Tab/Enter.
components.contract: Native popover and semantic nav; not role=menu or a roving-focus application menu.

components.title: Empty state
components.purpose: Explain missing data and one recovery destination.
components.intent: Distinguish an empty example from an error or loading state.
components.contract: Static explanation; actual empty/loading/error decisions come from application data.

components.title: Field and fieldset
components.purpose: Group a persistent label, native control and supporting help.
components.intent: Understand the question and enter a value without losing its name.
components.contract: Native fieldset/legend/label and described help; no application validation engine.

components.title: Hover / focus preview
components.purpose: Show a supplementary preview without replacing the primary link.
components.intent: Inspect extra context on hover, focus or explicit click.
components.contract: Native interestfor plus popovertarget click fallback; no hover-only essential content.

components.title: Text input
components.purpose: Provide a readable native single-line editor.
components.intent: Enter and select text with browser affordances and visible focus.
components.contract: Native text/search/email types; domain validation and storage are separate.

components.title: Input group
components.purpose: Associate a fixed prefix or suffix with an input.
components.intent: Understand units/context without putting fake values into the editable string.
components.contract: Persistent label stays outside; adornments do not replace the accessible name.

components.title: One-time code input
components.purpose: Keep a verification code in one native input.
components.intent: Paste or receive a whole code without scripted character-box navigation.
components.contract: One input, numeric inputmode, pattern, maxlength and one-time-code autocomplete; no verification request or auto-submit.

components.title: Item / list
components.purpose: Present comparable named rows.
components.intent: Scan items and use their explicit links without making whole rows clickable.
components.contract: Native list semantics and visible labels; selection/virtualization need logic.

components.title: Keyboard key
components.purpose: Distinguish a key name from an app control.
components.intent: Read a keyboard instruction without trying to click the keycap.
components.contract: Native kbd; no role=button or interaction handler.

components.title: Label
components.purpose: Keep a native control named.
components.intent: Activate the associated input by selecting its persistent label.
components.contract: Native for/id association; required wording is visible.

components.title: Text marker
components.purpose: Identify a relevant text fragment.
components.intent: Find the marked phrase without interpreting an alarm color.
components.contract: Native mark, neutral checked colors and a thin frame.

components.title: Application menubar
components.purpose: Distinguish an application menu from site links.
components.intent: Use the expected arrow-key and submenu behavior.
components.contract: Roving tabindex, command state and nested menu lifecycle require logic; semantic navigation is included.

components.title: Automatic message scroller
components.purpose: Keep chat scroll-state decisions explicit.
components.intent: Read earlier messages without forced jumps while new messages arrive.
components.contract: Unread tracking, stick-to-bottom conditions and streaming observation need logic; native scroll area is included.

components.title: Native select
components.purpose: Use the browser-owned option picker.
components.intent: Choose one value with native keyboard and mobile behavior.
components.contract: Real select/options; no custom listbox, filtering or async options.

components.title: Navigation links
components.purpose: Keep destinations grouped and keyboard reachable.
components.intent: Navigate named destinations with ordinary links and tab order.
components.contract: Semantic nav/list; no ARIA menubar or arrow-key submenu emulation.

components.title: Pagination links
components.purpose: Express the current position and available page destinations.
components.intent: Navigate a known page without confusing a visual index with loaded data.
components.contract: Visible numerical destinations 1–3 have descriptive names, real hrefs and aria-current=page; calculating result pages requires application logic.

components.title: Popover
components.purpose: Show nonmodal supporting information in the top layer.
components.intent: Open a named surface and dismiss it with Escape or a click outside.
components.contract: Native popover=auto and popovertarget; no manual aria-expanded synchronization.

components.title: Progress
components.purpose: Display an actual bounded completion amount.
components.intent: Read the quantity both as text and a native progress value.
components.contract: Static fixture value/max; measuring work completion is separate logic.

components.title: Questionnaire workflow
components.purpose: Separate question presentation from a response broker.
components.intent: Submit the intended structured answer exactly once.
components.contract: Branching, schema validation and agent continuation require the existing application contracts.

components.title: Radio group
components.purpose: Present mutually exclusive native choices.
components.intent: Use labels and arrow keys to choose one option.
components.contract: Shared native name, fieldset and legend; no invented custom selection state.

components.title: Resizable surface
components.purpose: Allow native CSS resizing of a bounded example workspace.
components.intent: Enlarge a nonessential inspection area while its content remains reachable.
components.contract: CSS resize handle is pointer-oriented, not an accessible split-pane replacement; text/content remains reachable without resizing.

components.title: Scroll area
components.purpose: Bound an inspection region without clipping content.
components.intent: Reach overflow by keyboard, pointer and native scrollbar.
components.contract: Named tabindex=0 region; native scrollbar, no custom drag engine.

components.title: Custom select/listbox
components.purpose: Keep a custom selection widget separate from its painted surface.
components.intent: Select reliably using its expected keyboard, focus and typeahead behavior.
components.contract: The bespoke listbox implementation needs logic; use the included native select when suitable.

components.title: Separator / divider
components.purpose: Separate topics without extra decorative panels.
components.intent: Recognize a change in content group.
components.contract: Semantic hr or an explicitly decorative rule; protected 1px boundary.

components.title: Sheet
components.purpose: Place a blocking support surface along the lower edge.
components.intent: Read and dismiss supplementary content with native modal behavior.
components.contract: Native dialog; no draggable sheet gestures or snap-position engine.

components.title: Sidebar
components.purpose: Group optional navigation or support next to content.
components.intent: Reveal a named support list without sacrificing source order.
components.contract: Native details inside aside; no persisted app layout or shortcut manager.

components.title: Skeleton
components.purpose: Reserve the shape of forthcoming content.
components.intent: Recognize placeholder structure alongside written loading text.
components.contract: aria-hidden static placeholder with an optional slow border-color animation, explicit opt-in and reduced-motion fallback; written loading remains visible.

components.title: Native range slider
components.purpose: Expose a bounded numeric choice.
components.intent: Change a value with native arrow keys or pointer input.
components.contract: input[type=range]; browser accessibility owns the value, no fake dynamic output.

components.title: Loading / spinner
components.purpose: Supplement a written loading state with an optional motion cue.
components.intent: Recognize ongoing work without motion being the only information.
components.contract: CSS animation explicitly enabled in the specimen; reduced motion retains a static cue and written text.

components.title: Switch
components.purpose: Present a named binary native preference.
components.intent: Toggle an explicit choice with native checked state and Space.
components.contract: Native checkbox role=switch with the existing track/thumb composition; no silent application save.

components.title: Table
components.purpose: Keep a small semantic comparison readable.
components.intent: Compare values under real headers without a custom grid widget.
components.contract: Native caption/th scope and bounded overflow; sorting/filtering remain excluded.

components.title: Tabbed links / native panel chooser
components.purpose: Offer linked destinations or a native choice between preloaded panels.
components.intent: Choose a labelled preview without a fake ARIA tab state.
components.contract: Folder-shaped radio labels retain native group, arrow-key and visible whole-label focus behavior; link folders remain navigation. Full ARIA tab synchronization requires logic.

components.title: Textarea
components.purpose: Provide a native multiline editor.
components.intent: Enter line breaks and resize notes vertically.
components.contract: Native rows and editable text; no rich-text editing or auto-save.

components.title: Toast presentation
components.purpose: Group a settled notification and its text.
components.intent: Read feedback without obscuring the active working area.
components.contract: In-flow notification stack in the reference; spawning, live timing, timers and dismissal policy need logic.

components.title: Checkbox button
components.purpose: Use native checkbox semantics for a persistent binary choice.
components.intent: See and change the selected option without a fake aria-pressed button.
components.contract: Visible checkbox with a styled label; a true aria-pressed button needs state synchronization.

components.title: Multiple toggle choices
components.purpose: Keep several persistent binary choices together.
components.intent: Select multiple explicit options with native checkbox behavior.
components.contract: Native fieldset/checkboxes; no ARIA toolbar or roving focus is claimed.

components.title: Tooltip
components.purpose: Offer supplementary noninteractive help without hiding required instructions.
components.intent: Read help on hover/focus/click and dismiss it without moving focus.
components.contract: Chrome native interestfor, hint popover and described text; explicit popovertarget is a click fallback.

components.title: Trace disclosure
components.purpose: Group a supplied sequence of diagnostic steps.
components.intent: Inspect an ordered explanation without mistaking it for live execution.
components.contract: Native details/ol presentation; capturing spans, timing and observability data need logic.

components.title: Typography
components.purpose: Use the established document reading layer.
components.intent: Navigate semantic headings, lists, quotations and code.
components.contract: Reuses the audited prose classes and separate content specimen.

components.title: Countdown number display
components.purpose: Keep supplied time fields aligned.
components.intent: Read an explicitly static duration example without a misleading running clock.
components.contract: Presentation only; clock reads, deadlines and ticking require application logic.

components.title: Comparison / diff view
components.purpose: Keep before/after content adjacent for inspection.
components.intent: Compare both versions without hiding either from keyboard or touch users.
components.contract: Paired comparison plus optional native CSS pointer-resize wipe; both full images remain separately readable. A keyboard range/drag engine is a separate widget.

components.title: Bottom navigation / dock
components.purpose: Group a small set of working-area destinations.
components.intent: Find the current location without floating over document content.
components.contract: Positioned within its bounded example surface, not a viewport overlay.

components.title: Corner action / speed dial
components.purpose: Keep a named corner action and secondary links together.
components.intent: Open the extra destinations with native click, keyboard and Escape behavior.
components.contract: Native popover; contained corner positioning avoids covering the page.

components.title: File input
components.purpose: Expose the browser-owned file chooser.
components.intent: Choose a file only after an explicit native action.
components.contract: Local selection only; no upload, reading, permission grant or persistence occurs.

components.title: Fixed-data filter
components.purpose: Filter a bounded preloaded example through native choice state.
components.intent: Select a visible criterion and restore all examples with Reset.
components.contract: Native radios/reset and CSS :has; querying stores or computing result counts needs logic.

components.title: Footer
components.purpose: Group document-end information and destinations.
components.intent: Find supporting links without confusing them with the main task.
components.contract: Semantic footer with wrapping links; no fixed viewport placement.

components.title: Introductory panel / hero
components.purpose: Introduce one purpose and a next destination.
components.intent: Understand the surface before choosing an action.
components.contract: Quiet neutral panel and existing heading scale; no full-screen marketing treatment.

components.title: Hover 3D
components.purpose: Demonstrate an optional spatial card treatment.
components.intent: Inspect the requested visual treatment without moving an interactive target.
components.contract: Decorative noninteractive card only, small immediate tilt; disabled for reduced motion and coarse pointers.

components.title: Hover gallery
components.purpose: Preview one of several supplied images.
components.intent: Use hover for a temporary preview or native radios for keyboard/touch selection.
components.contract: All choices remain reachable; no auto-advance, fetching or hover-only information.

components.title: Indicator
components.purpose: Place compact metadata beside its owning item.
components.intent: Read a written count/status in the correct context.
components.contract: Composes the offset badge owner and real numeric content with an accompanying explanation; no operational status meaning.

components.title: Link
components.purpose: Keep a destination distinguishable from plain text.
components.intent: Follow a meaningful underlined destination with native behavior.
components.contract: Native anchor, existing color/focus roles and an actual href.

components.title: Image mask
components.purpose: Demonstrate optional cropping of nonessential artwork.
components.intent: Compare shape treatments while retaining a written media explanation.
components.contract: Circle and polygon variants; never crop text or essential image information.

components.title: Large navigation popover
components.purpose: Group several destination categories in one requested surface.
components.intent: Open grouped links with ordinary keyboard navigation and native dismissal.
components.contract: Native popover/nav, responsive wrapping; no ARIA menubar, hover trap or fetched content.

components.title: Browser mockup
components.purpose: Frame a labelled example of a browser-like surface.
components.intent: Recognize illustrative chrome rather than real navigation controls.
components.contract: Static illustration with written mockup label; no fake functional toolbar.

components.title: Code mockup
components.purpose: Frame a labelled source example.
components.intent: Inspect source without mistaking the frame for an executable editor.
components.contract: Static pre/code composition and decorative caption only.

components.title: Phone mockup
components.purpose: Bound a small-device preview.
components.intent: Inspect a contained illustrative mobile layout without clipping its explanation.
components.contract: Static responsive frame, no device emulation or browser API.

components.title: Window mockup
components.purpose: Frame a labelled desktop-like example.
components.intent: Recognize the illustrative content area and caption.
components.contract: No fake close/minimize buttons or actual window control.

components.title: Navigation bar
components.purpose: Group identity and primary destinations.
components.intent: Locate navigation that wraps rather than disappearing on narrow screens.
components.contract: Semantic header/nav with normal source order; no scripted responsive menu.

components.title: Radial progress
components.purpose: Pair a supplied completion amount with a circular graphic.
components.intent: Read the written percentage and accessible value independently of color.
components.contract: CSS graphic derives from aria-valuenow; updating actual work progress requires logic.

components.title: Rating
components.purpose: Offer a bounded native single-choice scale.
components.intent: Choose a named rating with arrow keys and full-size labels.
components.contract: Each native radio option shows its own one-to-five filled star count and explicit accessible name. Selection uses the native check and emphasized boundary; no automatic write.

components.title: Visual stack
components.purpose: Indicate grouped material through nonessential background layers.
components.intent: Read the foreground item without hidden essential content beneath it.
components.contract: Only decorative rear layers overlap; all meaningful text remains in the foreground.

components.title: Statistic
components.purpose: Pair a supplied number with its meaning and period.
components.intent: Interpret a quantity without a dashboard number lacking context.
components.contract: Native definition structure and tabular digits; no invented live measurements.

components.title: Status
components.purpose: Keep a state label and supplementary mark together.
components.intent: Read the explicit state without relying on hue.
components.contract: Success, error, pending, information and neutral dots accompany written labels; status truth comes from the application.

components.title: Steps
components.purpose: Present a supplied process order and current step.
components.intent: Locate the current point without interpreting color alone.
components.contract: Native ordered list, written state and aria-current=step; no workflow advancement logic.

components.title: Swap
components.purpose: Switch between two supplied presentations using a native choice.
components.intent: Read an alternate detail level without replacing the control or saving anything.
components.contract: Visible checkbox and CSS states; the stable label describes the choice.

components.title: Text rotation
components.purpose: Demonstrate an optional sequence of supplementary labels.
components.intent: Inspect the effect while the complete wording remains persistently available.
components.contract: CSS animation opt-in, pause/reset control and reduced-motion fallback; essential text never exists only in the rotating layer.

components.title: CSS theme preview
components.purpose: Preview a complete local palette through native choice state.
components.intent: Compare brightness without a script, page-wide preference write or data change.
components.contract: CSS :has checkbox overrides the bounded preview; persistence and system-default resolution remain the existing preference script.

components.title: Timeline
components.purpose: Group supplied events in chronological order.
components.intent: Read event dates, descriptions and ordering as real text.
components.contract: Native list/time markup; collecting or sorting events requires logic.

components.title: Native validation styling
components.purpose: Expose browser-enforced input constraints with visible correction guidance.
components.intent: Correct an invalid example without a custom validation engine.
components.contract: Native required/type/pattern and :user-invalid; server/domain checks and custom error synchronization need logic.
